summary: Tested pre-acceptance customer<->driver chat with per-driver threads and contact masking (phone/email/UK postcode). All backend and frontend flows PASS. Created /app/backend/tests/test_chat_masking.py with 5 pytest tests (all passing). Verified via Playwright: customer /jobs shows enabled offer-msg-<driver_id> buttons, chat modal opens with masking disclosure mentioning phone/email/address, sent message with phone+email+postcode is stored and rendered with [contact hidden] and [address hidden]. Per-driver threads are separated (Driver A's messages don't leak into Driver B's chat). Driver drv1 sees pre-acceptance conversation in Driver Hub Message tab (conversation-<booking_id>), can view customer message, reply, and reply is visible round-trip.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1755 lines — consider splitting into routers (chat, driver, bookings, admin) for maintainability.
_PHONE_RE is loose (matches 8+ digit numeric-like strings). Acceptable since worst case is over-masking; noted but not a blocker.
GET /api/bookings/{id}/messages does not paginate (limit 500). Fine for MVP.
/api/driver/conversations does O(N) per-booking queries; consider aggregation if convo counts grow.
test_credentials: customer@example.com/Customer#2026, drv1@example.com/Drive#2026 (both valid, /app/memory/test_credentials.md not used since creds were supplied)
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing quoting booking MWV3BF4AD59 with 5 offers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend chat endpoints: GET/POST /api/bookings/{id}/messages accept ?driver_id (required for customer, optional for driver=self, admin can pass). GET /api/driver/conversations lists per-driver threads for the logged-in driver (both pre-acceptance where they were messaged and assigned bookings). mask_message() masks _PHONE_RE, _EMAIL_RE ('[contact hidden]') and _POSTCODE_RE ('[address hidden]'). Legacy messages (no driver_id) surface only in the assigned driver's thread via _thread_query $or. drv1's user_id is user_6a05a366314e; note drv1 is NOT in the seeded instant-offer pool (offer drivers are Drv A/B users user_063208b71748, user_f636ff8d1b93, user_1512e61d0cb0, user_d4b3d318f0e7, user_1de2f36750ca), so pre-acceptance test messages drv1 directly by driver_id (server accepts any driver_id from customer).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 6 requested features work end-to-end.
